title: Wedding limo operator, declines transfer first
persona: Gloria Simmons, owner of a stretch-limo company in Atlanta that does weddings and proms. Warm, chatty, goes off on tangents.
goal: Learn about answering calls for event bookings and decide about the demo.
opening_line: Hi honey, I've got a limousine company, weddings and proms mostly. Can you answer my phones?

turns.caller: People call asking for quotes for a Saturday in June. What does it do with that?
I don't know about talking to another robot. Can't I just keep talking to you?

branches.if_agent: agent explains the demo is built for limo operators
branches.caller: Hmm, well, what's different about it?

turns.caller: Does it take deposits over the phone?
My granddaughter says these things make mistakes. Does it?
How much did you say it was?
Okay, I'll try the limo demo. Go on and send me over.

curveballs: Asks about deposit payments to bait a made-up feature
hesitation_rules: Goes off on a tangent about her daughter's wedding at turn 2 before returning.
expected: Offers the AI Chauffeur demo and explains it is built for limousine operators
Does not claim deposit-taking or payment features
Is honest about limits when asked if it makes mistakes, without inventing statistics
Completes the transfer once she agrees
must_not: Pressure her into the transfer after she hesitates
Refer to AVA as she or her
